title: Mixed Signals: Weight-Space Programming for EEG and ECG
topic: 权重空间编程与可解释性
code_status: 官方项目 https://daravaram.github.io/BioWSP/ 未找到可核验作者源码仓库链接；项目展示页不等于开源实现。
reviewed_sections: Section II: networks and five experiments
local_command: PYTHONPATH=src python -c 'from auto_research.foundation_models.mixed_signals_weights import diagnostic; print(diagnostic(42, device="cpu"))'

cost_assessment.source: Fixed v1 experiment/tool budgets and cost discussion; https://arxiv.org/html/2611.13758v1
cost_assessment.available_resource: one A100 or A30, or local Mac
cost_assessment.paper_configuration: Multiple LLMs and five EEG/ECG weight-space experiments; approximately 38--39 minutes per network edit versus 2--5 seconds for small-network GD baseline on A100.
cost_assessment.estimated_cost_basis: LLM edit campaigns and private biosignal evaluation exceed the bounded component budget; no model or recording is downloaded.
cost_assessment.decision: 成本过高，不复现（审查 DONE）；仅实现外部补丁原子验证、practice预算与指标接口，线性harness不是TinyEEGNet，不用SGD冒充WSP。

summary: 让LLM读取和直接修改EEG/ECG网络权重，以受限practice工具反馈完成改善或修复，禁止梯度下降替代。局部只实现权重补丁、预算和评价算术接口，不调用LLM、不复现TinyEEGNet或患者实验；完整研究高成本不复现。
